nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 1$, $m \ge 0$ and $n \ge 1$. The number of compositions of $n$ with exactly $m$ parts not congruent to $1$ modulo $k$, all of which are greater than $k$, equals the number of compositions of $n + k - 1$ with exactly $m$ parts less than $k$ in which every part less than $k$ is preceded by a part at least $k$ and is followed by a part that is either the last part or greater than $k$.
nodes.title: Huang's Franklin-type identity for compositions

nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 1$ and let $m$ and $n$ be natural numbers. The number of partitions of $n$ in which exactly $m$ distinct part sizes occur at least $k$ times equals the number of partitions of $n$ in which exactly $m$ distinct part sizes are divisible by $k$.
nodes.title: Franklin's partition identity

nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 2$, $m \ge 0$ and $n \ge 1$. Among the compositions of $n + k - 1$ with exactly $m$ parts less than $k$ in which every part less than $k$ is preceded by a part at least $k$ and followed by a part that is either the last part or greater than $k$, let $b^{(m)}_{k,n}$ be the number with an odd number of parts minus the number with an even number of parts. Then $b^{(m)}_{k,n}$ is the sum of…
nodes.title: Signed count of Huang's compositions, monomial form

nodes.summary: Let $k, n \ge 1$ and $m \ge 0$. Among the compositions of $n + k - 1$ with exactly $m$ parts less than $k$ in which every part less than $k$ is preceded by a part at least $k$ and followed by a part that is either the last part or greater than $k$, let $b^{(m)}_{k,n}$ be the number with an odd number of parts minus the number with an even number of parts. Then $b^{(m)}_{k,n}$ is the sum of…
nodes.title: Signed count of Huang's compositions, binomial form

nodes.summary: Let $r > s \ge 0$, let $k = r - s$ and let $n \ge 1$. Among the compositions of $n + k - 1$ whose parts are all at least $k$ and congruent to $k + s$ modulo $r$, the number with an odd number of parts minus the number with an even number of parts is $1$ if $n = s + 1$ and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Signed count of residue-class compositions with parts at least $r - s$

nodes.summary: Let $r > s \ge 0$, let $k = 2r - s$ and let $n \ge 1$. Among the compositions of $n + k - 1$ whose parts are all at least $k$ and congruent to $k + s$ modulo $r$, let $b^{r,s}_{k,n}$ be the number with an odd number of parts minus the number with an even number of parts. Then $b^{r,s}_{k,n} = (-1)^j$ if $n = 3rj + s + 1$ or $n = 3rj + r + s + 1$ for some $j \ge 0$, and $b^{r,s}_{k,n} = 0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Signed count of residue-class compositions with parts at least $2r - s$

nodes.summary: Let $k, n \ge 1$ and $r > s \ge 0$. Among the compositions of $n + k - 1$ whose parts are all at least $k$ and congruent to $k + s$ modulo $r$, the number with an odd number of parts minus the number with an even number of parts is the sum of $(-1)^j \binom{i+j}{i}$ over all $i, j \ge 0$ with $ri + j(k+s) + s + 1 = n$ (an empty sum when $n \le s$).
nodes.title: Signed count of compositions with parts at least $k$ in a residue class

nodes.summary: Let $k, n \ge 1$. Among the compositions of $n + k - 1$ whose parts are all at least $k$, the number with an odd number of parts minus the number with an even number of parts equals $\sum_{j=0}^{\lfloor (n-1)/k \rfloor} (-1)^j \binom{n-1-j(k-1)}{j}$.
nodes.title: Signed count of compositions with parts at least $k$

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 0$, among the compositions of $n + 1$ whose parts are all greater than $1$, the number with an odd number of parts minus the number with an even number of parts is $(-1)^j$ if $n = 3j + 1$ or $n = 3j + 2$ for some $j \ge 0$, and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Signed count of compositions with parts greater than one

nodes.summary: Let $k, n \ge 1$ and $m \ge 0$. Among the compositions of $n + k - 1$ with exactly $m$ parts less than $k$, the number with an odd number of parts minus the number with an even number of parts is the sum of $(-1)^{i+\ell+1} \binom{i+j-1}{j} \binom{i}{m} \binom{m}{\ell}$ over all $i, j, \ell \ge 0$ with $i + j + (k-1)(\ell + i - m - 1) = n$, where $\binom{-1}{0} = 1$.
nodes.title: Signed count of compositions with exactly $m$ parts less than $k$

nodes.summary: The only composition of $0$ is the empty one, which has no parts and so is even. Hence the signed count of all compositions of $0$, the number of odd compositions minus the number of even ones, is $-1$.
nodes.title: Signed count of the compositions of zero

nodes.summary: For a natural number $N$ and a property $P$ of compositions of $N$, the signed count of the compositions of $N$ satisfying $P$ is the number of them with an odd number of parts minus the number with an even number of parts. Equivalently, it is the sum of $(-1)^{\ell(c) + 1}$ over all compositions $c$ of $N$ satisfying $P$, where $\ell(c)$ is the number of parts of $c$.
nodes.title: Signed count of compositions

nodes.summary: If every entry of a finite sequence of natural numbers is at least $k$, then the sequence satisfies Huang's placement condition for $k$, vacuously.
nodes.title: Sequences without small parts satisfy Huang's placement condition

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a natural number. A finite sequence $(a_0, \dots, a_{\ell - 1})$ of natural numbers satisfies the placement condition for $k$ when every entry $a_i < k$ has a preceding entry and a following entry, the preceding entry satisfies $a_{i-1} \ge k$, and the following entry $a_{i+1}$ is either the last entry (that is, $i + 2 = \ell$) or satisfies $a_{i+1} > k$.
nodes.title: Huang's placement condition for small parts

nodes.summary: Let $r \ge 1$ and $n$ be natural numbers, and let $E(n)$ and $O(n)$ be the numbers of partitions of $n$ into distinct parts, each congruent to $0$, $2r + 1$ or $2r - 1$ modulo $4r$, with an even and an odd number of parts, respectively. If $n = j(2rj + 1)$ or $n = j(2rj - 1)$ for some integer $j \ge 0$, then $E(n) - O(n) = (-1)^j$; otherwise $E(n) - O(n) = 0$.
nodes.title: Nyirenda's identity for distinct parts modulo a multiple of four

nodes.summary: Let $r \ge 1$ and $n$ be natural numbers, and let $E(n)$ and $O(n)$ be the numbers of partitions of $n$ into distinct parts, each congruent to $0$, $r$ or $r + 1$ modulo $2r + 1$, with an even and an odd number of parts, respectively. If $2n = j((2r + 1)j + 1)$ or $2n = j((2r + 1)j - 1)$ for some integer $j \ge 0$, then $E(n) - O(n) = (-1)^j$; otherwise $E(n) - O(n) = 0$.
nodes.title: Nyirenda's identity for distinct parts modulo an odd number

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $E(n)$ and $O(n)$ be the numbers of partitions of $n$ into distinct parts with an even and an odd number of parts, respectively. If $2n = j(3j + 1)$ or $2n = j(3j - 1)$ for some integer $j \ge 0$, then $E(n) - O(n) = (-1)^j$; otherwise $E(n) - O(n) = 0$.
nodes.title: Legendre's identity for partitions into distinct parts

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
